statement: Polynomial existential conditions over an algebraically closed field admit a finite branched-gcd elimination algorithm in every characteristic
depends_on: Euclidean gcd; root multiplicity bound; denominator clearing
notes: Complete elementary derivation; standard elimination principle; no priority claim

statement: For fixed r and n simultaneous matrix tuples have a finite list of canonical polynomial and eigenvalue-order parameter templates with finite canonical decomposition
notes: Explicit repeated-diagonal encoding; terminal stable scalar cells and n=1 included; disjoint pivot branches and deterministic records remove duplicates

statement: For algebraically closed odd-characteristic fields every fixed dimension and minimal coefficient degree has finite canonical indecomposable O_m templates with computable duality and polynomial form types
notes: Nested finite coalgebras from degree-compatible standard monomials; exact dual algebra relations; idempotent and determinant filters; no unclassified isomorphism quotient

statement: Over algebraically closed odd-characteristic fields split WG(BO_m) has an explicit canonical parameter basis and finite product and exterior-power algorithms
notes: Finite per(n,d), exact field/root/order access; weights1,2,dual pairs; no efficiency or finite-generation claim; nonclosed and nonfield bases excluded

statement: For O3 Sym2V is absolutely indecomposable of symmetric type in characteristic3 and is 1 plus an absolutely indecomposable rank5 symmetric module in characteristic5
notes: Complete sign/permutation/rotation proof and coordinate-Hopf-algebra certificate at p3,p5; product and lambda2/lambda3 identities explicit
